info.title: PaletteAI
info.description:
PaletteAI extracts, explores, evaluates and organises colour palettes from images.

**For plugin developers:** start with the *plugins* section below and `docs/PLUGINS.md`.
Every error response has the shape `{"detail": {"code": "...", "message": "..."}}`.
Users are plain profile names (`user=guest`); there is no authentication because the app runs locally.

schema.title: Response Health Api V1 Health Get

post.summary: Upload an image and extract its dominant palette
post.description:
Validates the file, normalises it, clusters its pixels in CIELAB with K-Means and stores the result.

Uploading the same bytes again with the same `k` returns the stored palette (`cached: true`).

get.description: Includes colours with coverage, colour-vision simulations, WCAG contrast for every colour pair, and this user's saved/feedback state.

put.summary: Save a palette to a user's library (or rename it)

delete.summary: Remove a palette from a user's library

put.description: Feedback immediately updates the user's preference model used by `GET /ranking`.

delete.summary: Clear a user's feedback on a palette

get.description:
Ranks palettes by similarity to the user's liked palettes and dissimilarity from disliked ones.

With no feedback yet (`model.status = cold_start`) palettes are returned newest first with score 0.

schema.title: Response List Plugins Api V1 Plugins Get

post.description:
PaletteAI will POST a `PanelRequest` to `hook_url` whenever one of the chosen slots is shown,
and render the `Panel` the plugin returns. See `PanelRequest` and `Panel` in the schemas below.

get.summary: Collect plugin panels for a UI slot
get.description:
Used by the web app to fill its plugin area. A plugin that errors or times out yields `ok: false`
with a message instead of breaking the page.

schema.title: Response Panels Api V1 Panels Get

get.summary: Tint/shade scales for a stored palette

schema.title: Response Scales Api V1 Ext Tints And Shades Palettes  Palette Id  Get

post.summary: Sent to a webhook plugin's hook_url
post.description:
PaletteAI POSTs this to every registered webhook plugin subscribed to the slot being shown.
Reply within 3 seconds with a `Panel`; it is rendered inside the app. Errors and time-outs
are shown to the user as a small notice and never break the page.
